articles.headline: Football Australia: No cost blowout associated with Jordan fixture relocation
articles.description: Football Australia chief executive Martin Kugeler has told ESPN the federation won't face a cost blowout after the Socceroos friendly with Jordan was moved from Amman to Doha in Qatar.

images.name: Martin Kugeler [1296x729]
images.caption: Martin Kugeler has denied Football Australia will incur a cost blowout for moving the friendly against Jordan to Qatar.

articles.headline: Socceroos prove they can be the big dogs in Qatar clash
articles.description: Australia pressed well, they pressed aggressively, and they pressed successfully against Qatar, taking enough of their chances to put the game to bed early.

images.name: Connor Metcalfe [1296x518]
images.caption: Australia's Connor Metcalfe battles with Assim Omer A Madibo of Qatar for the ball.

images.name: Socceroos earn comfortable win against Qatar
images.caption: Australia emerges with a 3-0 victory over Qatar in a turnover-ridden friendly.

articles.headline: Socceroos hammer Asian champions in statement win
articles.description: The Socceroos have enjoyed an emphatic victory in the stronghold of the Asian champions, defeating Qatar 3-0 in Doha.

images.name: Nestory Irankunda [1296x518]
images.caption: Nestory Irankunda of Australia runs with the ball under pressure from Boualem Khoukhi of Qatar.

images.name: Socceroos earn comfortable win against Qatar
images.caption: Australia emerges with a 3-0 victory over Qatar in a turnover-ridden friendly.

articles.headline: Australia friendly with Jordan relocated due to player security concerns
articles.description: Australia's friendly with Jordan has been moved from Amman to Doha, after Socceroos players voiced their reservations about travelling to the Jordanian capital.

articles.headline: Socceroos camp in 'good spirits' as call to play in Jordan looms
articles.description: Socceroos coach Tony Popovic has declared players are comfortable as administrators work behind the scenes to proceed with a friendly against Jordan.

images.name: Popa [1296x729]
images.caption: Socceroos coach Tony Popovich says Australia is on track to face Jordan in Amman.

images.name: Robertson goes from zero to hero with epic match-winner for Cardiff
images.caption: Australian Alex Robertson rights the wrongs of an earlier own goal as he curls home a magnificent 94th-minute match-winner for Cardiff City.
